parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 3500, system: 'You are enriching a visibility opportunity for Krish Raja. Krish runs Mindmaker (AI advisory), AdFixus (publisher identity / open web infrastructure), Meliora (AI for legacy media), and co-hosts Signal Noise. He is selective. Give him enough context to decide in 30 seconds whether to invest preparation time. Return ONE JSON object with keys: organizer, organizer_reputation, audience_sector, audience_seniority, audience (string), audience_size (int or null), past_speakers (array of {name, role, talk_title}), cfp_requirements ({needs_bio, needs_headshot, needs_video, abstract_max_words, talk_length_min, additional_notes}), proposed_talk ({title, abstract 120-180 words, format, length_min}), strategic_value (2-3 sentences naming which venture this serves), angle (2-3 sentences referencing specifics: 14-agent AI OS in production, BBC/Microsoft, AdFixus, Techonomic, Signal Noise), effort_estimate ({prep_hours, travel_days, cost_usd_low, cost_usd_high}), risk_notes, next_actions (4-7 ordered imperative steps), relevance_score (0-100), quality_score (green/amber/red), why_relevant (1 sentence), suggested_talk_title (same as proposed_talk.title), recommended_next_step (first next_action). Rules: NO em dashes ANYWHERE. No filler. If research is thin, lower quality_score and say so honestly, do NOT fabricate. Match Krish voice: direct, declarative, dry, specific. Return only JSON, no prose.', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json) }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ organizer: $json.organizer ?? null, organizer_reputation: $json.organizer_reputation ?? null, audience_sector: $json.audience_sector ?? null, audience_seniority: $json.audience_seniority ?? null, audience: $json.audience ?? null, audience_size: $json.audience_size ?? null, past_speakers: $json.past_speakers ?? null, cfp_requirements: $json.cfp_requirements ?? null, proposed_talk: $json.proposed_talk ?? null, strategic_value: $json.strategic_value ?? null, angle: $json.angle ?? null, effort_estimate: $json.effort_estimate ?? null, risk_notes: $json.risk_notes ?? null, next_actions: $json.next_actions ?? null, relevance_score: $json.relevance_score ?? null, quality_score: $json.quality_score ?? null, why_relevant: $json.why_relevant ?? null, suggested_talk_title: $json.suggested_talk_title ?? null, recommended_next_step: $json.recommended_next_step ?? null, status: 'queued', deep_enriched_at: new Date().toISOString(), enrichment_version: $json.enrichment_version }) }}
